phase_link_profile.notes: NIC overlaps may overlap each other; do not sum them. Mixed GPU busy is separate.

drain.stopping_rule: Advance in 10 s batches; stop after all measurement arrivals complete or tail cap.
drain.interpretation: If no censoring, lower-bound metrics are exact full-output metrics. Otherwise they are bounds, not an imputed completed distribution; TPOT uses elapsed span / target output intervals, with zero only for the explicitly flagged trivial bound before first decode.

metric_scope: Top-level throughput and latency are fixed measurement window; drain metrics are ONLY under drain. Do not mix protocols.
